items.title: Brock Bowers: Could play this week without practicing
items.text:
Coach Klint Kubiak noted Wednesday that Bowers (ankle) doesn't need to practice this week in order to play Sunday Sunday against the Broncos, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.
